title: The Open Passage
author: P. M. Galloway
blurb: Quentin Delacroix, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
